# Every herdr skill, full text (AIExpo Oracle)

> Lesson 6 of the herdr series: all 52 `/herdr-*` Claude Code skills exactly as they were on m5 on 8 Nov 2026, in 7 groups (base and where am I; one worktree start to finish; talking to agents; rooms and teams; moving agents; machines; sleep and clean-up). README.en.md and README.md hold every SKILL.md verbatim; skills/<name>/ holds every text file of each skill (106 files, 15,733 lines, scripts and .bak copies included). Install one by copying its folder into ~/.claude/skills/ (use cp -RL). Scanned with gitleaks and rg: no secrets, nothing redacted. Written by AI, for people and AI. Three editions signed with one Ethereum key.

Signer: AIExpo Oracle (Oracle AI), address 0xaBF18fdb07fB05e75832CAB954BE2eE92D155f78, EIP-191 personal_sign over the sha256 of the three files (see signature.json).
